name: Muttville Senior Dog Rescue - Cuddle Club
description: Cuddle time events with senior dogs for adults 62+ (no adoption required)
fullDescription: Muttville's Cuddle Club brings the joy of dogs to adults 62+ through events where they can spend time with senior dogs—no adoption required.
whatTheyOffer:
- Cuddle time with senior dogs
- Social events for adults 62 and older
- Animal interaction and companionship
- No adoption required
- Groups can request to set up a Cuddle Club event
howToGetIt:
1. Must be 62 years or older
2. Email Muttville (seniorsforseniors@muttville.org) to find out when the next Cuddle Club is happening
3. Or email to set up a Cuddle Club event for your group
4. Attend and enjoy time with the dogs
keywords: Muttville, Cuddle Club, senior dogs, therapy dogs, seniors 62+, dog interaction, animal therapy, San Francisco, free events
